recipes.title: Garlic Tofu and Mushroom Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Golden tofu, browned mushrooms, and silky spinach tangle with noodles in a savory garlic sauce.

ingredients.amount: 14 ounces (400 g), drained and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
6 ounces (170 g), dry, with an 8-minute or shorter cook time
2 tablespoons, plus enough to boil noodles

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and pat the tofu thoroughly dry.
Cook the noodles according to the package directions, drain, and set aside.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the tofu for 7–8 minutes, turning to brown several sides.
Transfer the tofu to a plate, add the remaining oil, and cook the mushrooms for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute.
Return the tofu, add the noodles, soy sauce, water, and vinegar if using, and toss for 2 minutes until hot.
substitutions: Replace wheat noodles with rice noodles and soy sauce with gluten-free tamari for a gluten-free version.
Replace spinach with thinly sliced bok choy.
tips: Use egg-free noodles to keep the dish vegan.
Dry tofu well so it browns rather than steams.

recipes.title: Tofu, Spinach, and Mushroom Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Soft tofu and tender noodles float with mushrooms and spinach in a fragrant garlic vegetable broth.

ingredients.amount: 4 ounces (115 g), dry, with a 5-minute or shorter cook time

steps: Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes until softened and lightly browned.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and tofu and bring to a gentle boil.
Add the rice noodles and simmer according to the package directions, up to 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and simmer for 1 minute until wilted.
Taste, add salt as needed and lemon juice if using, and divide between bowls.
substitutions: Replace firm tofu with silken tofu, adding it gently with the spinach.
Use quick-cooking egg-free wheat noodles instead of rice noodles; these add wheat/gluten.
tips: Choose rice noodles that cook directly in simmering liquid.
Serve promptly so the noodles do not absorb all the broth.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Tofu Pasta with Mushrooms and Spinach
recipes.summary: A velvety blended tofu sauce coats pasta with golden mushrooms and tender spinach for a comforting vegan meal.

ingredients.amount: 6 ounces (170 g), dry, with a 10-minute or shorter cook time
1/2 cup for sauce, plus enough to boil pasta

steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package directions.
Blend the tofu, 1/2 cup water, lemon juice, half the salt, pepper, and nutritional yeast if using until completely smooth.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms with the remaining salt for 5–6 minutes.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds, then add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water and drain the spaghetti.
Reduce the skillet heat to low, add the tofu sauce and spaghetti, and toss for 2–3 minutes until heated through.
Loosen the sauce with reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time and serve.
substitutions: Use silken tofu instead of firm tofu and reduce the sauce water to 1/4 cup.
tips: Blend thoroughly for the smoothest sauce.
Keep the sauce over low heat to prevent it from drying out.
